question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

See eye to eye
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"See eye to eye"** means to be in full agreement with someone. (किसी से पूरी तरह से सहमत होना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite their differences, they finally saw **eye to eye** on the new policy.
 
 
 
• **"Agree"** refers to having the same opinion as someone else; to concur. (सहमत होना)
 
 
• **Example: **They agreed to meet at the café at 5 PM.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To ignore someone** (किसी को नज़रअंदाज़ करना): To deliberately pay no attention to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to ignore him after their argument.
 
 
 
• **To get upset with something** (किसी बात से नाराज़ होना): To become unhappy or angry about something.
 
 
• **Example: **He got upset with the delay in the project.
 
 
 
• **To do something pointless** (बेमतलब का काम करना): To engage in an activity that has no useful outcome.
 
 
• **Example:** Arguing with him is pointless; he never listens.
 
 

51:Td45,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
